Better RAWM Hub is a free, open-source a: Better RAWM Hub is a free, open-source alternative to the RAWM HUB desktop software. It talks to the device over WebHID straight from Chrome or Edge, so DPI stages, polling rate, lift-off distance, angle tuning, motion sync, lighting, button mapping, advanced keys and macros can be changed without installing anything. Every change is written to the mouse and stored in its onboard memory.
